svg.title: The sum only grows; the average settles and can fall again
svg.desc: Two charts of the cache G against the step t, both starting at 0. Left, on log-log axes, a gradient of constant size 0.5 for 100,000 steps: AdaGrad's sum is 0.25 t, 0.25 at step 1, 2.5 at step 10, 2,500 at step 10,000 and 25,000 at step 100,000; RMSProp's average with rho 0.9 is 0.025 at step 1 and 0.1628 at step 10, is within 1 percent of 0.25 from step 44 and stays at 0.25. Right, the gradient is 2 for 1,000 steps and 0.1 afterwards, on a log cache axis: AdaGrad holds 4,000 at step 1,000 and 4,200 at step 21,000; RMSProp with rho 0.9 falls from 4 to within 1 percent of the new level 0.01 in 101 steps; with rho 0.999 it has reached only 2.5292 at step 1,000, is at 0.9363 at step 2,000 and needs 10,130 steps to settle at 0.01. Marks: steps the script prints.
svg.text: The sum only grows; the average settles and can fall again
AdaGrad: G ← G + g2​. RMSProp: G ← ρG + (1 − ρ)g2​. Both caches start at 0.
Marks: steps the script prints. Step counts: steps after the change until within 1 percent of 0.01.
